optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Service Delivery Manager, Card Dispute Handling
professionalSummary: Experienced Service Delivery Manager with three years of running the card dispute handling service in production, managing production incidents, and ensuring scheme deadline compliance.
experienceHighlights: Led live dispute service operations, holding the production support rota and escalation procedures; handled two major case‑routing outages with documented incident records.
Coordinated monthly production changes with card operations and technology, clearly delineating responsibilities in the change log.
Maintained and updated the service runbook and deadline performance reports, feeding accurate data into quarterly scheme reports.
Authored comprehensive post‑incident and hand‑over notes, documenting known limitations and hand‑over conditions.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Service runbook (updated after each incident and change); deadline performance report for the last two quarters; incident records for two case‑routing outages with operations incident register identifiers.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s direct experience managing the dispute handling service, handling incidents, coordinating changes, maintaining runbooks and reports, and documenting limitations. They do not provide independent verification of the impact on scheme deadlines or external stakeholder feedback.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate meets all listed requirements based on evidence; human review recommended to confirm impact on scheme deadlines and stakeholder satisfaction.

role.roleTitle: Service Delivery Manager, Card Dispute Handling

evidence.text: Ran the card dispute handling service in production for the bank's cardholder portfolio for three years, holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.
Handled the production incidents logged against the service in that period, including the two case-routing outages of the last year, with incident records filed in the operations incident register.
Holding the production support rota and the deadline escalation procedure for the dispute agents.
Coordinated production changes with card operations and technology in the monthly change window, recording in the change log which checks were mine and which belonged to technology.
Maintained the service runbook and the deadline performance report that fed the quarterly scheme reports, updating the runbook after each incident and each change.
Wrote the post-incident notes and the change hand-over notes, listing the known limitations of the case-routing rules and the conditions handed to the next rota holder.
evidence.notes: Documentation of limitations and hand‑over claim
